comments.author: @CaliAxmedGoondar
comments.text:
To the creator: Thank you for taking the time to make this video! Your effort and good intentions are greatly appreciated.

I wanted to gently share a few factual corrections to make your content even better:

Visual Content & AI Artifacts: Some of the visual depictions (both people and animals) appear AI-generated and feature non-Somali elements—such as two-humped (Bactrian) camels native to Central Asia rather than the single-humped dromedaries found in Somalia. A quick review and refinement of the generated visuals would really help keep the representation authentic.

Physical Features & Geography: Somalis are indigenous to the Horn of Africa (Afro-Asiatic/Afro-Arab roots) and share much closer physical/ethnic features with neighboring Horn populations like Ethiopians than with East Africans further south, such as Kenyans.

Demographics: There are currently over 35 million Somali speakers across the Horn of Africa.

Thanks again for your work and for sharing this—keep it up!
